expanded_hypotheses.note: The new main theorems have NO hypotheses beyond construction data: n : ℕ and h : Sphere n ≃ₜ Sphere n. sphereOfTwoDisks additionally assumes an actual compact T2 space X with closed A, B covering X, homeomorphisms A ≅ Disk (n+1), B ≅ Disk (n+1), the condition that the first chart maps A ∩ B exactly onto the boundary sphere Sphere n, and the compatibility of the two charts on A ∩ B through h. All of these are expanded and each is used except that the symmetric second-chart boundary condition was found unnecessary and removed. No triangulability/smoothness/locally-euclidean hypothesis appears.
